title: Nourishing Spicy Algerian Kimchi Tagine
description: A hearty, spicy, and energizing Algerian-inspired dish featuring fermented kimchi and ayurvedic-friendly black pepper. Serve with crusty bread or couscous for a satisfying brunch or breakfast.

ingredients.name: kimchi
ingredients.notes: homemade or store-bought, spiced with fish sauce and chili flakes

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay pot or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional minute.
Add the kimchi, ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and water, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
